scripts.data:dev: uv run python -m playlens_ml.data.preprocess --dataset nfl_bdb_2026_analytics --subset dev
scripts.data:full: uv run python -m playlens_ml.data.preprocess --dataset nfl_bdb_2026_analytics --subset full
scripts.ml:baseline: uv run python -m playlens_ml.evaluation.evaluate --predictor cv --split validation
scripts.retrieval:load: uv run python -m playlens_api.retrieval.ingest --model-version trajectory-gnn-transformer-v1 --subset full
scripts.retrieval:verify: uv run python -m playlens_api.retrieval.verify --model-version trajectory-gnn-transformer-v1 --subset full
scripts.retrieval:benchmark: uv run python -m playlens_api.retrieval.benchmark --model-version trajectory-gnn-transformer-v1 --subset full
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && uv run mypy services/api ml
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web test && uv run pytest
